rubric: Impact = how much HAVING this document as a finished, reusable asset would improve business results for a luxury Las Vegas home-staging company. Weigh: (1) Revenue & conversion — does it directly help win/close more staging jobs or raise price? (2) Lead generation & brand — does it drive inbound leads, referrals, or reputation? (3) Operational leverage — is it used on most jobs, saving time or raising quality at scale? (4) Foundational dependency — does it standardize or unlock many other documents/workflows? Score 1-100. Tier: High = 70-100, Medium = 45-69, Low = 1-44. Compliance/admin docs that are necessary but do not move revenue should score Medium or Low.
